authority.REGISTER_ACTOR.meaning.literal: Register a principal without granting case or administration capabilities.

authority.SET_ENABLED.meaning.literal: Enable or disable an actor. The final enabled human owner remains protected.

authority.SET_GRANT.meaning.literal: Grant or revoke a role at installation or case scope.

command.AMEND_REGISTRATION.meaning.literal: Replace the initial facts. The handler's case reference remains unchanged.

command.CLEAR_PAYMENT.meaning.literal: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.

command.CLOSE.meaning.literal: Close the case. Closing does not mean that payment was made.

command.CORRECT_CASE.meaning.literal: Correct recorded details on a case with a decision, payment or closed status. All changes are recorded together. Clearing a payment date does not refund money.

command.DECIDE.meaning.literal: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.

command.ERASE.meaning.literal: Permanently remove business payload from the live database. WAL, backups and copies elsewhere are not erased.

command.OPEN.meaning.literal: Register the incident, claimant, insurer and amount claimed.

command.RECORD_PAYMENT.meaning.literal: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.

command.REINSTATE.meaning.literal: Restore ordinary case work on a voided record.

command.REOPEN.meaning.literal: Reopen the case, preserving its details and history.

command.VOID.meaning.literal: Block business commands while retaining the case and its history.

command.WITHDRAW_DECISION.meaning.literal: Clear the unpaid decision while preserving its history.

diagnostic.CASE_AMENDMENT_REQUIRES_UNDEC.literal: “Amend registration” requires an undecided case. Use “Correct case facts” to correct recorded registration while keeping its decision.

diagnostic.CASE_CLOSED.literal: This action cannot change a closed case. Use “Correct case facts” for factual corrections while keeping its status, or “Reopen the case” when you intend to resume ordinary case work.

diagnostic.CASE_DECISION_ALREADY_PAID.literal: “Record payment decision” and “Withdraw payment decision” cannot change a paid decision. Use “Correct case facts” for a factual correction, with explicit payment reaffirmation or clearing when replacing a paid decision.

diagnostic.CASE_NOT_FOUND.literal: The case reference was not found.

diagnostic.CASE_PAYMENT_NOT_RECORDED.literal: There is no payment record to clear.

diagnostic.CASE_REVISION_CONFLICT.literal: Read the current case before making a changed request.

diagnostic.CASE_ZERO_DECISION_CANNOT_BE_.literal: A zero decision is not a payment.

diagnostic.COMMAND_EXPECTED_REVISION_RAN.literal: Use an integer revision from 0 through 9007199254740991.

diagnostic.CORE_INTERNAL_ERROR.literal: An internal error occurred. Stop and investigate.

diagnostic.CORE_OPERATION_CONTENT_CONFLI.literal: Stored operation content is inconsistent. Stop and investigate.

diagnostic.CORE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.literal: The schema differs from this build. Run migrate or use a matching build.

diagnostic.CORE_STORE_INTEGRITY_ERROR.literal: Stored data failed verification. Stop and run verify.

diagnostic.CORRECTION_EXISTING_VALUE_REQ.literal: A correction can only replace or clear a value already recorded on this case.

diagnostic.CORRECTION_NO_CHANGES.literal: Choose at least one factual correction that changes the current case.

diagnostic.CORRECTION_PAYMENT_ACKNOWLEDG.literal: Replacing a paid decision requires explicit payment reaffirmation or clearing the payment record.

diagnostic.CORRECTION_PAYMENT_CLEAR_REQU.literal: Clearing a paid decision requires clearing the payment record.

diagnostic.HOST_COMPLETEDRESPONSEFAILED.literal: The completed response could not be delivered.

diagnostic.HOST_CONTRACTMISMATCH.literal: The client contract differs. Reload or use a matching client.

diagnostic.HOST_DISPATCHUNCONFIRMED.literal: Preserve the exact request and replay it.

diagnostic.HOST_INPUTINVALID.literal: The input does not satisfy the endpoint contract.

diagnostic.HUMAN_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED.literal: This role requires a human principal.

diagnostic.INPUT_CALENDAR_DATE_REQUIRED.literal: Use one valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

diagnostic.INPUT_CASE_REFERENCE_FORMAT.literal: Use 1 to 80 printable non-space ASCII characters.

diagnostic.INPUT_COUNTRY_FORMAT.literal: Use two uppercase ASCII letters for the country code.

diagnostic.INPUT_CURRENCY_FORMAT.literal: Use three uppercase ASCII letters (A–Z) for the currency identifier.

diagnostic.INPUT_DATE_ORDER.literal: The dates are in an invalid chronological order.

diagnostic.INPUT_DECIMAL_FORMAT.literal: Use non-negative decimal text: up to
fractional digits; no sign or exponent.

diagnostic.INPUT_FUTURE_DATE.literal: A future date cannot record an event that has already occurred.

diagnostic.INPUT_SURROUNDING_WHITESPACE.literal: Leading or trailing whitespace is not accepted.

diagnostic.LAST_OWNER.literal: At least one enabled human owner is required.

diagnostic.LEDGER_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED.literal: The ledger has reached its final sequence.

diagnostic.OPERATION_CONTENT_CONFLICT.literal: This operation ID belongs to different command content. Do not reuse it.

diagnostic.QUERY_CURSOR_INVALID.literal: Use one current opaque case-list cursor returned by ClaimCore.

diagnostic.REVISION_EXHAUSTED.literal: The case has reached its final revision.

diagnostic.TEXT_FORMATTING_CHARACTER.literal: Formatting characters are not accepted in a new assertion.
